name: Business Major

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students admitted to the Beedie School of Business for the Fall 2017 term onwards must complete the Business Foundation Pathways within their first year.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students admitted through internal or external transfer must complete the Business Foundation Pathways - Transfer Stream.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor

sections.title: Upper Division Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: In the last 60 units, students must complete a minimum of 36 upper division units in business courses, which must include the following.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: All core courses (see Core Courses below) an area of concentration (see Areas of Concentration below) at least three 400 division BUS courses (excluding practicum courses and BUS 478).

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Any 400 division BUS course completed at SFU must be worth a minimum of three units to be used to fulfil this requirement. 400 division BUS courses worth zero units cannot be used to fulfil this requirement.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: At least one of these 400 division BUS courses must be completed at Simon Fraser University.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor

sections.note:
Other 400 division courses deemed to have significant international business relevance may, with prior faculty permission, be substituted for the above courses.
These may be offered in another faculty.
A course substitution for international business cannot be used for any other concentration.
Students concentrating in international business are strongly advised to consider combining it with another business concentration.

sections.title: Other requirements
sections.note:
NOTE: SFU students accepted in the accelerated master’s within the Beedie School of Business may apply a maximum of 10 graduate course units, taken during the final term of the bachelor’s degree, towards the upper division electives of the bachelor’s program and the requirements of the master’s degree.
For more information go to: https://www.sfu.ca/gradstudies/apply/programs/accelerated-masters.html .

sections.title: Beedie School of Business Non-Business Elective Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students are required to complete a minimum of nine units, outside of the Beedie School of Business, that is centered around the School’s Calling and offers an Indigenous perspective.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students must complete a minimum of six units from Group A and a minimum of three units from Group B.

requirements.title: 6 units from ECON 342, GA 101, GEOG 100 and 50 more
requirements.note: Students must complete a minimum of six units from the following list of courses. Lists: Global Perspective, Innovation, Social Responsibility, Multiple Themes (Global Perspective, Innovation, Social Responsibility).

requirements.note: Students must complete a minimum of three units from the following list of courses.

grades.label: Grade Requirements
grades.text: In addition to normal university grade point average requirements, the Beedie School of Business requires a minimum 2.30 overall SFU Business course grade point average for entry into all 300 and 400 division business courses.

grades.label: Grade Requirements
grades.text: A minimum 2.30 overall SFU Business course grade point average is required for graduation from a business major, joint major, or double degree program.
